[stable/grafana] Make envFromSecret value be templated (#22109)

* Make grafana.envFromSecret value be templated

The grafana chart provides a good way to supply
extra environment variables that can be loaded
from an already existing secret by specifying the
'envFromSecret' value to the name of an existing
secret object.

Making this be templated allows combining the grafana
chart in the same Release with other charts that would
generate that secret.

[stable/grafana] Make watch METHOD environment variable of dashboard sidecar container configurable (#20558)

Starting with kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar:0.1.75 METHOD also supports a SLEEP mode that lists all ConfigMaps and sleeps for 60s. This fixes issues where long running watch requests may break because of assumptions in software defined network solutions.

See also https://github.com/kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar/pull/52
